summary: Phase 1 completed (henkin_bfmcs sorry-free BFMCS on Int), Phase 2 blocked: schedule-based chain cannot prove restricted temporal coherence because F-persistence through g_content is not guaranteed
blockers: Schedule-based chain (g_content + Lindenbaum) cannot guarantee F-resolution: F(phi) is not a G-formula and does not propagate through g_content. Plan incorrectly claims temp_future_derived provides F(phi)->G(F(phi)); it gives Box(phi)->G(Box(phi)). F(phi)->G(F(phi)) is semantically invalid under strict temporal ordering. This is the same obstacle that killed plans v2, v3, and RootScopedChain.lean.
Restricted BUC also blocked for Henkin chain: the backward direction needs the chronicle's C4 property (counterexample elimination), which is not built into the schedule-based chain.

All three restricted coherence conditions (TC, BUC, FUC) require structural properties that only the chronicle construction provides, but the chronicle's integer mapping requires succ_embed_surjective (sorry via succ_cofinal).
